applicant_utility.summary: This is an internally funded Chulalongkorn University award for non-Thai-passport students already inside a Master's or PhD programme, and it pays tuition, a monthly living allowance and round-trip airfare for the second semester of academic year 2026. The university publishes the benefit categories but no figures, so budget planning must be done without a stated amount. Applying is a single Google Form submitted by 31 October 2026, but your own submission is only stage one - your faculty must then put you on its endorsement list by 7 November for you to reach the committee. Treat the faculty relationship as the real gate: a student who submits the form but is never endorsed by their faculty is not evaluated.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Non-Thai-passport Master's and doctoral students already admitted to Chulalongkorn University who need tuition, living-cost and airfare support for one semester starting January 2027.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your passport is not a Thai passport before anything else - the call excludes Thai-passport holders outright
Confirm you are admitted to, or currently studying in, your first semester at Chulalongkorn University in a Master's or doctoral programme
Find and open the current Google Form from the official call page rather than a cached or forwarded link, since the form URL is the only application route published
Speak to your faculty or graduate office early about endorsement, because faculties must submit endorsement lists by 7 November and you cannot control that step after the 31 October deadline
Keep the submitted-form confirmation (screenshot or email response) as your own proof of submission
Email int.off@chula.ac.th with any eligibility doubt before submitting rather than after the deadline
common_rejection_risks: Holding a Thai passport while assuming 'international student' is judged by nationality of study or residence - it is not; the published rule is passport-based
Applying too late in your studies: only students admitted to or currently in their FIRST semester qualify, so a second-year student who is otherwise strong is simply outside the call
Missing the faculty step: the form reaches the scholarship committee only through faculty endorsement, so a complete form with no faculty backing goes nowhere
Applying for a programme level outside the call (bachelor's, diploma or non-degree study)
Assuming next semester's round exists - this call is specifically for the second semester of academic year 2026
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The published components are tuition fees, a monthly living allowance and round-trip airfare only; the call page lists no other covered items and no figures. Applicants should still expect to fund their own visa and extension fees, health insurance if their programme requires it, accommodation deposits and setup, local transport, books and research materials, and any additional home-country travel beyond the single round trip.
document_audit: The call page publishes no document list at all - the entire intake is one online form, so do not wait for a document checklist that will not be issued and do not assume transcripts, references or an English certificate will be requested; anything your faculty needs for its endorsement is separate from this form
The online form is the only published route - there is no email or in-person application path, and a form saved but not submitted before 31 October 2026 counts as no application
Your passport details in the form must match the non-Thai-passport rule; a mismatch discovered after the faculty stages wastes the whole cycle
alerts: Deadline is 31 October 2026 with no published extension or late window, and the form link can change between rounds - always start from the official OIA page

The internal pipeline is fast: faculty endorsement by 7 November, committee review 8-10 November, results 12 November, contract signing and visa processing from 12 November, semester start January 2027 - successful applicants have only weeks to complete contract and visa steps
The round-trip airfare and monthly allowance are listed without amounts, so the actual value of the award cannot be compared with other offers from the official page alone

This is a university-internal award, not a government or external scholarship - eligibility comes from being admitted to Chulalongkorn, not from applying separately for admission through this scholarship
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Applicant submits the Google Form by 31 October 2026; faculty compiles and submits its endorsement list by 7 November; the scholarship committee reviews 8-10 November; OIA posts results on its website on 12 November; winners sign the contract and start visa processing from 12 November; orientation and classes begin January 2027.
